category_title: Student with developmental delay and learning disabilities exhibiting disruptive behaviors and repetitive questioning
minimal_context: Dang is sitting in a group during classroom instruction.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Okay everyone, please sit in your groups and look at the board for our instruction.

STUDENT: Teacher, what are we doing? What are we doing?

TUTOR: We are starting our group lesson.

STUDENT: But what are we doing? Teacher, what are we doing?

TUTOR: Just listen to the instruction, please.

STUDENT: Teacher, what are we doing? What are we doing? Teacher, what are we doing?

options.A: Add a section to the opening of the class defining communication expectations, requesting that all questions be held until the end of instruction.
options.B: Create a seating arrangement in groups so that the student can always be a part of one of the groups during instruction.
options.C: Progressively and methodically tune the student's awareness to each body part, followed by intentionally relaxing each part from toes to head.
options.D: Provide a clear beginning and end for each task during the group lesson when the student is sitting with their peers.
